test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage from Privacy Policy and verify trip type selection

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'One way' radio button on the child page
And then check that the 'One way' radio button is selected

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and perform a flight search

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Type $name into 'Departure' input field on the child page
Type $name into 'Destination' input field on the child page
Click 'Search' button on the child page
And then check that the search results are displayed based on the entered departure and destination

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and apply a promo code

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'Apply promo code' button on the child page
And then check that the promo code input or confirmation is displayed

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and view cookie settings

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'View cookie settings' button on the child page
And then check that the cookie settings panel is displayed

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and accept cookies

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'Yes, I agree' button on the child page
And then check that the cookie consent popup is dismissed and preferences are saved

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and decline cookies

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'No, thanks' button on the child page
And then check that the cookie consent popup is dismissed and preferences are saved

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and open next notification in carousel

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'Open next notification' button on the child page
And then check that the next notification is displayed in the carousel

test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage and open previous notification in carousel

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click 'Open previous notification' button on the child page
And then check that the previous notification is displayed in the carousel
